results.title: TikTok Support
results.content:
From a search

1. In the TikTok app, tap the Search button at the top.

2. Enter what you're looking for in the search bar, then tap Search.

3. Tap Shop at the top.

4. Tap Filters to sort through and refine your search results. Tap Apply after you select the filters.

5. Tap an item to get more details about the product.

6. Tap Buy now, then follow the steps to make the purchase, or tap Add to cart to continue shopping.

Keep in mind that you can go to your shopping cart at the top of the Shop Tab to check out at any time.

### Safe shopping on TikTok Shop

We're committed to providing a safe and secure online environment for our community. The following resources are available to safeguard your shopping experience. [...] Note: TikTok Shop is only available in the TikTok app.

### How to buy on TikTok Shop

You can make purchases on TikTok Shop directly from the Shop Tab, your feeds (For You, Following, Friends, and LIVE), and search results.

From the Shop Tab

1. In the TikTok app, tap Shop.

2. Browse content to shop or search for your desired item.

3. Tap an item to get more details about the product.

4. Tap Buy now, then follow the steps to make the purchase, or tap Add to cart to continue shopping.

From your feeds

1. In the TikTok app, go to a post that contains a link to a product.

2. Tap the shop link above the creator's nickname.

3. Tap Buy now, then follow the steps to make the purchase, or tap Add to cart to save it for later.
